ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  This document is a routine compliance certificate from Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited (ASAL) confirming adherence to SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. It certifies that all physical securities received for dematerialization during this period were duly processed, mutilated, cancelled, and registered in the depositories' names within prescribed timelines, and remain listed on stock exchanges. There are no red flags; this filing indicates good corporate governance and efficient investor services related to the company's share registry operations.
